Mentor Coaching

Toward Mastery - Mentor Coaching with Dr Ben Koh

Coaches change lives by empowering individuals to go after what they most desire and achieve a satisfaction they never thought possible.

The Mentor Coaching program has been developed specifically for Coaches who want to change lives. You will be well on your way to mastering the ICF Core Coaching Competencies following your Coach Masters Academy transformative coach training. Now, with practice and Dr Ben's guidance, you will have expert help to master the coaching process and accelerate your learning.

MCCMaster Certified Coach

Ben is a true master of his craft. He is authentic, energetic and engaging. He was personally mentored by ICF pioneers such as Janet Harvey, Amorah Ross, Jenny Bird, Molly Gordon, and Duncan Coppock. Since then, he has trained and supported more than 2000 coaches across the globe in their professional development from 2013 to 2023

Ben knows how to help you take your coaching to the next level. His gentle approach will leave you with insights that will help you recognise and appreciate your strengths, and together, you will uncover your hidden potential for greater effectiveness and artistry.

You will return your renewed confidence to your client sessions with even better results.

How the mentor coaching works?

As a Certified Mentor Coach, Ben will review your coaching conversations with real clients. His focus will be on assessing your skills in relation to the process and flow of the conversation. The objective of mentor coaching is for you to hone your coaching awareness skills.

Ben will analyse your client's responses based on your questions and then look behind the conversation to help you discover your thought processes and enable you to fully demonstrate the competencies at the credential level qualification you are seeking. Through this process, you deepen your learning of yourself which helps you to better observe your inner processes in relation to how you help your clients as i.e. What is happening within you and what happened and why it matters. In a supportive and affirmative manner, you are then offered valuable suggestions on where your growth opportunities are

The Mentor Coaching Package will include

  1. Review of your recording
  2. Prepare Process Review Report
  3. Debrief to identify growth opportunities

Competency Review:

Based on the ICF Assessor System, this review will provide you with an in-depth review of the demonstration of the Core Competencies in your coaching session. You will receive valuable feedback with practical solutions on how best you can improve to meet the credential requirements you are applying for.

Process Review:

Your recordings are analysed segment by segment. You will receive valuable detailed feedback about improving the coaching process to demonstrate mastery in coaching the client for awareness. Although labour-intensive, this process enables Ben to provide practical suggestions, including actual questions you can use, that will allow you to improve your coaching process.

The Review Report and Ben's feedback will be provided from your transcript recordings. This report will suggest how you can improve the flow of the conversation to allow the client to go deeper and learn more.

Mentor coaching package

Your mentoring sessions will focus on correcting, improving and enhancing your ability to demonstrate the core competencies to meet the specific level you are applying for. Depending on your competencies, you can opt for the following Package:

Package 1 [ Standard Package ]
@ US$1200

This package is designed for those who wish to apply for your ICF Credential at ACC

  • 3 Individual Debriefing based on Dynamic Review [ 90 mins per session ]
  • 4 Group Learning [ join any of the existing Supervised Practical Coaching as a Student Mentor ]
Package 2 [ Developmental Package ]
@ US$3000

This extensive package is designed especially for those applying for ICF credentials at MCC. It is also beneficial for those who wish to continue to hone their coaching skills to heighten their awareness and deepen their understanding of mastery skills. From 2019 to 2024, Dr Ben supported 50 coaches in achieving the MCC Credential.

  • 5 Individual Debriefing based on Dynamic Review [ 90 mins per session ]

High praises from coaches

One of the best ways to grow your business and attract clients is to become credentialed with the International Coach Federation. This makes you more credible to prospects and current clients; it SETS YOU APART from the myriad of people calling themselves a coach. An ICF credential is your differentiator in the marketplace.

Mentor Coaching is an important requirement of the ICF Credentialing process and is vital to the development and growth of the individual seeking an ICF Credential. You can accelerate your coaching competencies and acquire ICF Credential with Ben Koh, Certified Master Coach. Mentor Coaching is available for ACC, PCC & MCC Level.
